workarounds.symptom: zenml 0.98.0: **Concurrent deployed pipeline invocations with remote orchestrators**: ZenML no longer lets per-invocation step runner cleanup clear the deployment service’s process-wide run cont
workarounds.workaround: Fix: **Concurrent deployed pipeline invocations with remote orchestrators**: ZenML no longer lets per-invocation step runner cleanup clear the deployment service’s process-wide run context. Concurrent `/invoke` calls against deployments that use remote orchestrators such as Kubernetes should no longer race and fail with `RuntimeError: Run context not initialized`. [PR #5159](https://github.com/zenml-io/zenml/pull/5159). Upstream PR #5159. (Ref: https://github.com/zenml-io/zenml/pull/5159)

workarounds.symptom: zenml 0.97.0: **Capped exponential backoff overflow**: Retry loops using capped exponential backoff no longer keep calculating ever-growing delay values after the maximum delay has been reached.
workarounds.workaround: Fix: **Capped exponential backoff overflow**: Retry loops using capped exponential backoff no longer keep calculating ever-growing delay values after the maximum delay has been reached. This prevents `OverflowError` failures in very long-running retry scenarios while preserving the configured maximum delay behavior. [PR #5265](https://github.com/zenml-io/zenml/pull/5265). Upstream PR #5265. (Ref: https://github.com/zenml-io/zenml/pull/5265)

workarounds.workaround: Fix: **Fewer SQLite lock failures for local stores**: Local SQL stores backed by SQLite now wait up to 60 seconds for write locks instead of using Python’s 5-second default. This reduces `sqlite3.OperationalError: database is locked` failures when concurrent steps, such as mapped dynamic pipeline steps, finish and publish artifacts at the same time. [PR #5096](https://github.com/zenml-io/zenml/pull/5096). Upstream PR #5096. (Ref: https://github.com/zenml-io/zenml/pull/5096)
